senses.gloss: f. (אהל) a group of tents, encampment; only in Pl. אָהֳלִיּוֹת (= castra) camps. (Always in connection with בצוצריות or קסטרא fortifications).
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:13">Cant. R. to II, 13</cite>.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 1:11">Lev. R. s. 1</cite>; a. e. [Cmp. <cite ref="B01081"><he>בְּצוֹצְרִיּוֹת</he></cite> a. <cite ref="C01169"><he>גַּסְטְרָא</he></cite> as to versions.]
